item.title: Everything You Need to Know About Placebos in Cancer Clinical Trials
item.description: Would a placebo make cancer worse? Will I know if I am given a placebo in a clinical trial? Get answers to your pressing questions about placebos.

item.title: How the Phases of Menstruation Affect Your Mood
item.description: Learn more about the four phases of the menstrual cycle, and how they can cause both physical and emotional changes from week to week.

item.title: Is Red Meat Actually Good for You?
item.description: The new Dietary Guidelines for Americans 2025–2030 promote red meat as a nutrient-rich source of protein, despite concerns about the link to heart disease and cancer. Learn more about the pros and cons.

item.title: Rat Urine and Feces Exposure Prompt Recall of Thousands of Grocery Items in 3 States
item.description: Gold Star Distribution recalled brand-name foods, drugs, and household goods in 3 states after inspection found highly unsanitary conditions at its facility, the FDA said.

item.title: 4 Low-Calorie Alcoholic Drinks for Weight Loss
item.description: Registered dietitians recommend these low-calorie alcoholic beverages over others if you're going to drink alcohol.

item.title: Overview of Libtayo, First FDA-Approved Drug for Metastatic Cutaneous Squamous Cell Carcinoma (CSCC) When Surgery or Radiation Isn’t an Option
item.description: Libtayo is a type of immunotherapy drug. It is the first FDA-approved treatment for cutaneous squamous cell carcinoma (CSCC) in cases where removing a tumor by surgery or radiation isn’t feasible.

item.title: What Is Frequent Urination? Symptoms, Causes, and Treatment
item.description: Frequent urination may indicate a UTI, diabetes, or prostate issues. Learn about symptoms, causes, and treatments to manage this condition effectively.

item.title: How to Read Codes on Canned Foods
item.description: Learning to read the most commonly used codes that refer to dates helps ensure your canned foods are fresh and safe to eat. Some canned foods include a noncoded “use by” date stamped on the can or label.

item.title: What to Eat When You Have a Fever (and What Foods to Avoid)
item.description: Discover the best foods to eat when you have a fever to help ease symptoms. Learn about foods to avoid when you are sick, according to experts.

item.title: Side Effects of Hemp Protein
item.description: Hemp protein powder side effects are rare, but may include allergy, abdominal upset from excess fiber, and potentially high intakes of certain minerals.
